title: CultivAgents: Cultivating Relationship-Centered Multi-Agent Systems for Personalized Gardening

bias_targets.methodology: Expert evaluation and qualitative analysis of system responses to culturally specific gardening prompts to identify instances of cultural flattening and the inappropriate collapsing of distinct indigenous/local practices into broad regional identities.
Expert feedback assessing the system's ecological specificity and contextual relevance, comparing the quality of advice for well-documented agricultural regions against under-documented ones.
